title: Labor Schedule Clause — Warranty Tire and Caster Replacement on Mobility Equipment
content:
# Labor on a Warranty Tire or Caster Replacement — Mobility Equipment

Summit Ridge claims from the chair manufacturer the labor of every tire or caster replacement done under the manufacturer's tire and caster warranty on a Mobility Equipment chair, in whole 15-minute units, and posts that claim on the repair job.

> The units claimed for a warranty caster replacement are the standard caster allowance of 2 units.

## The figure in minutes

2 units of 15 minutes are 30 minutes of labor; the claim is a whole number of units.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

Both front casters of a Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) are replaced under the manufacturer's tire and caster warranty. The repair job carries a claim of 2 units against the manufacturer.
